name: Swallow's Tail
source:
Play a young female glaciologist as she is dragged into events leading to first contact with an alien civilization. A gripping story filled with adventure, romance, and fateful decisions.

[From [url=https://xaandera.itch.io/swallows-tail]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演一位年轻的女性冰川学家，她被卷入导致第一次接触外星文明的事件中。一个充满冒险、浪漫和命运决定的扣人心弦的故事。

[来自[url=https://xaandera.itch.io/swallows-tail]Itch.io[/url]]
